scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rick-and-morty/web && npm run build --workspace @rick-and-morty/api
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "npm run start --workspace @rick-and-morty/web" "npm run start --workspace @rick-and-morty/api"
scripts.dev:apps: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api "npm run dev --workspace @rick-and-morty/web" "npm run dev --workspace @rick-and-morty/api"
scripts.dev: npm run infra:up && npm run dev:apps
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --project tsconfig.tools.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/shared/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:application && npm run test:smoke
